# hhfa008.github.io — Games & Tools

> A static, login-free site with 24 browser games and 3 local-first tools. No tracking, no external dependencies, no account system; game state stays in the browser.

Updated: 2026-11-10
Canonical: https://hhfa008.github.io/
Languages: zh-CN, en, id

## Start here

- [Games hall](https://hhfa008.github.io/games/): All 24 games, Chinese entry point.
- [English games hall](https://hhfa008.github.io/games/en/): Same games, English entry point.
- [Indonesian games hall](https://hhfa008.github.io/games/id/): Same games, Indonesian entry point.
- [Tools hall](https://hhfa008.github.io/tools/): The three local-first tools below.

## Game documentation

- [games/README.md](https://hhfa008.github.io/games/README.md): Maintenance rules, test expectations, release gates, and the authoritative game table.
- [games/TASKS.json](https://hhfa008.github.io/games/TASKS.json): Machine-readable task board; 36 tasks with commands, probes, dependencies, and effort.
- [games/AGENT-CONTRIBUTING.md](https://hhfa008.github.io/games/AGENT-CONTRIBUTING.md): Why this repo suits agents, determinism notes, safety boundaries, and a 10-minute walkthrough.
- [games/RETENTION.md](https://hhfa008.github.io/games/RETENTION.md): Retention evidence, measured gaps, and prioritised work (2026-11-10).
- [games/HANDOFF.md](https://hhfa008.github.io/games/HANDOFF.md): Project handoff, hard-won deployment rules, and the current gap list.
- [games/tests/HEALTH.md](https://hhfa008.github.io/games/tests/HEALTH.md): Which games have automated tests and which do not.
- [games/registry.json](https://hhfa008.github.io/games/registry.json): Authoritative machine-readable metadata for every game.

## Games (24)

- [24 Game](https://hhfa008.github.io/games/24game/): Cards, 1 player. Make 24 from four cards; solver-checked deals.
- [Aeroplane Chess](https://hhfa008.github.io/games/aeroplane/): Party, 2–4 players. Chinese aeroplane race with one AI level.
- [Backgammon](https://hhfa008.github.io/games/backgammon/): Board, 2 players. Standard 24-point setup, bar, bearing off, three AI levels.
- [Banqi (Dark Chess)](https://hhfa008.github.io/games/banqi/): Board, 2 players. 4×8 half-hidden Chinese chess variant.
- [Chinese Checkers](https://hhfa008.github.io/games/checkers-jump/): Board, 2–6 players. 121-hole star board.
- [Chess](https://hhfa008.github.io/games/chess/): Board, 2 players. Full rules including castling, en passant, promotion; perft-tested.
- [Connect Four](https://hhfa008.github.io/games/connect4/): Board, 2 players. Gravity drops and four-direction wins.
- [Dou Dizhu](https://hhfa008.github.io/games/doudizhu/): Cards, 3 players. Chinese climbing card game with a rule-based AI.
- [Draughts 8×8](https://hhfa008.github.io/games/draughts/): Board, 2 players. Mandatory capture, chains, kings.
- [FreeCell](https://hhfa008.github.io/games/freecell/): Cards, 1 player. Standard FreeCell with undo.
- [Go 9×9](https://hhfa008.github.io/games/go9/): Board, 2 players. Captures, ko, suicide rule, area scoring.
- [Gomoku](https://hhfa008.github.io/games/gomoku/): Board, 2 players. Five-in-a-row; shared rules engine with the voice room.
- [Mahjong](https://hhfa008.github.io/games/mahjong/): Mahjong, 4 players. Three AI levels; shared winning-hand evaluator.
- [Pioneers of Nine Isles](https://hhfa008.github.io/games/pioneers/): Euro, 2–4 players. Build, trade, and settle nine islands.
- [Reversi](https://hhfa008.github.io/games/reversi/): Board, 2 players. Eight-direction flips and final count.
- [Solitaire (Klondike)](https://hhfa008.github.io/games/solitaire/): Cards, 1 player. Draw 1 / Draw 3, best time and moves.
- [Spider Solitaire](https://hhfa008.github.io/games/spider/): Cards, 1 player. Difficulty levels and best results.
- [Tap Match](https://hhfa008.github.io/games/tap-match/): Casual, 1 player. Timed tap-and-clear with local best score.
- [Ember Deck Forge](https://hhfa008.github.io/games/tcg-deck/): Cards, 1 player. Deck workshop that reads the shared card set.
- [Lamptongue: Duel of Embers](https://hhfa008.github.io/games/tcg-sample/): Cards, 2 players. Original deterministic card duel with replay support in the engine.
- [Texas Hold'em](https://hhfa008.github.io/games/texas-holdem/): Cards, 4 players. Three AI levels; shared poker hand evaluator.
- [Undercover](https://hhfa008.github.io/games/undercover/): Party, 4–12 players. Word-assignment social deduction.
- [Voice Room](https://hhfa008.github.io/games/voice-room/): Online, 2–4 players. WebRTC voice plus tic-tac-toe, Gomoku, and Connect Four; Cloudflare Worker signaling.
- [Xiangqi](https://hhfa008.github.io/games/xiangqi/): Board, 2 players. Chinese chess with horse-leg, elephant-eye, cannon-screen, and flying-general rules.

## Tools (3)

- [WebRTC network diagnostics](https://hhfa008.github.io/tools/rtc-diag/): STUN / TURN / signaling connectivity test.
- [Sari-sari store credit ledger](https://hhfa008.github.io/tools/sari-sari-ledger/): Offline credit ledger (utang); data stays in the browser.
- [Screen sharing latency calculator](https://hhfa008.github.io/tools/screen-share-calc/): Encode budget, bitrate, and degradation estimates.

## Technical constraints

- **No tracking**: no analytics, tag managers, session replay, error reporting SDKs, or `sendBeacon`.
- **No external dependencies**: no CDNs, external fonts, icon libraries, or third-party scripts; boards and pieces are inline SVG/CSS.
- **Single-file games**: CSS and JS are inline in each `index.html`, except shared engines under `games/shared/` (`rules.js`, `shuffle.js`, `sfx.js`, `physics.js`, `hand-eval.js`, `tcg.js`) and `games/pioneers/engine.js`.
- **No accounts**: scores, settings, and streaks are local `localStorage` only; there is no cross-device sync.
- **Only networked feature**: the voice room (WebRTC mesh plus a Cloudflare Worker / Durable Object for signaling and authoritative moves).
- **Offline**: the service worker caches the halls and game pages; per-game manifest / install entry is still an open task in `games/TASKS.json`.
- **Testing**: `node games/tests/run-all.js` runs every unit test; `node scripts/check-tasks.js` drives the agent task board.
